name: dumbbell incline squeeze press
description: Press two dumbbells held together up from an incline bench. The constant squeeze keeps the chest working through the whole rep.
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back with dumbbells pressed together over your chest.
Keep squeezing them against each other the whole set.
Lower them slowly to your upper chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched back and feet planted.
